name: HubSpot Quota vs Actuals Variance Forecast Bot (Safe-by-Default)

parameters.content:
## Quota vs Actuals: Variance Forecast Bot

**Safe by default.** With no env vars this runs in **SANDBOX_MODE** on a synthetic fixture (portal 99000001): zero network calls, nothing posted, no CRM updates. Slack / Teams payloads appear in **Dry-Run Preview**.

Go-live needs explicit opt-ins:
`SANDBOX_MODE=false` · `DRY_RUN=false` · `NOTIFICATIONS_ENABLED=true` (+ webhook URL in env, host allowlisted) · optional `HUBSPOT_MUTATIONS_ENABLED=true` (hygiene flags only).

Fail-closed: failed / truncated searches abort; bad-data ratio and missing quotas block posting. Secrets only via `$env`. See README.md.
